title: Electrode Coating
description: Electrode coating composition and quantitative properties.

active_material.description: Active material component(s) of the coating.

additive.description: Alias of conductive_additive, kept for compatibility. Conductive additive component(s) of the coating (e.g. carbon black).

conductive_additive.description: Conductive additive component(s) of the coating (e.g. carbon black, CNT). Preferred over the legacy `additive` key.

other_additive.description: Non-conductive functional additive component(s) of the coating (e.g. thickener, dispersant, lithium-compensation additive).

component.description: Coating composition by role: active material, binder, conductive additive, and other additives. Each component carries its mass_fraction of the dry coating solids under property (0-1 with unit '1', or 0-100 with unit '%'); the fractions across all roles sum to 1.

supplier.description: Supplier or vendor the item was sourced from.

property.description: Named quantity map of coating-level properties (e.g. loading in mg/cm2 per side, thickness per side, porosity, calendered_density, areal_capacity). See the property keys reference for the full list of recognised keys.
